notes.title: Update #42
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32623881/1324a45d0073fd068559d2aec05aec9081b0c0d2.jpg[/img]

[i]Version: 1.7.45.200.
Download Size: 257 MB.[/i]

Hello again everyone! We continue our marathon of updating [b]Fated Kingdom[/b] digital board game. This time we decided to tackle improvements in several areas at once. First, we brought back animated cursors that were gone after upgrading to a new version of the Unity engine.

Secondly, we slightly revised the rulebook based on your feedback. Coins no longer count towards victory points, but towers do! We've also expanded descriptions on combat dice and game board. Along with that, we reworked «Relentless Knight», which raised questions after the escape mechanic was removed. We hope that now it will be easier for beginners to get used to.

Thirdly, we fixed a bug with the fate sphere, tightened the layout on the guild selection screen, and improved the display of english fonts. And modders can now clear numeric values ​​instead of removing the entire card.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32623881/756f6ff781787b134d38bb04f34c1e5d853d5735.jpg[/img]

[h3]Rulebook:[/h3]
[list][*]The rules for scoring when the game ends early have been changed again: coins are not counted, but towers are.
[*]Added instructions in case the player got on the road sign on the Outer path.
[*]Added a list with values ​​for each of the three types of combat dice.[/list]

[h3]Bug Fixes:[/h3]
[list][*]In rare cases, the information on the guild selection screen could be displayed incorrectly.
[*]Some special symbols were not displayed in the description of the cards of the english version.
[*]Fate sphere might not work for everyone except the host.[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32623881/47e05678177a5dd11375de66b34792493c5a77e5.jpg[/img]

[h3]Other Changes:[/h3]
[list][*]«Relentless Knight» card now prevents wounds from being healed in combat, and its value is increased by 1.
[*]A function for clearing numeric fields has been added to the editor.
[*]Animated cursors returned.
[*]Minor text and localization fixes.[/list]

Thank you for playing [b]Fated Kingdom[/b]!

notes.title: Update #41
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32623881/58d4e8f9228fa17bb6cd704b501fe1ca47305716.jpg[/img]

[i]Version: 1.7.44.200.
Download Size: 249 MB.[/i]

After the release of the last update, we began to receive messages about errors and crashes. Unfortunately, our team of two people was not strong enough to thoroughly test the last build and save it from all the problems. Therefore, we decided to release an update aimed at fixing all the bugs we noticed. If you have had them before, then be sure to try the new version of [b]Fated Kingdom[/b]!

We also decided to change one problematic card - «Wheel of Fortune». It caused a lot of questions and negatively affected the dynamics of the game. This now has a much clearer condition that is easy to track. It was also decided to slightly change the «Cliff» square so that it does not repeat one of the other squares on the game board. In addition, this change should slightly reduce the average match time.

There is another update ahead, the content of which will be announced shortly. Follow the news!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32623881/34b16425e46736d2ad5ce7fa248f87d472ed8986.jpg[/img]

[*]«Wheel of Fortune» now requires defeating a creature without being wounded.[/list]

[h3]Bug Fixes:[/h3]
[list][*]After picking up the same object multiple times, the sound of interaction with it could disappear.
[*]All players' cursors could turn blue right after the start of the game.
[*]Match restart could fail on second use.
[*]Wounds could fall through the game board.
[*]Dice could shake slightly on their own.
[*]Missing background on card gallery and Rulebook screens.[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32623881/ddad6046bb3f9c37687cbe6d0e1c526471eec49d.jpg[/img]

[h3]Other Changes:[/h3]
[list][*]Changed the scoring rules for early game completion: now not only creatures and items, but also coins and skills are taken into account.
[*]Minor text and localization fixes.[/list]

Thank you for playing [b]Fated Kingdom[/b]!

notes.title: Update #40
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32623881/5ab44af3635d109f0c0a420e58e746e049d23f5d.jpg[/img]

[i]Version: 1.7.43.200.
Download Size: 262 MB.[/i]

In this 40th [b]Fated Kingdom[/b] update, we are proud to bring you a redesigned game board rendering system. Previously, the entire central part of the playing field was generated by a single object with its very large texture, which took up a lot of video memory and created some other problems during development. Now squares are created as separate elements in the same way as the faces of cards.

This allowed once again to improve optimization and make the game more comfortable for owners of low-tier PCs. We also reworked a couple of problem cards and made a number of clarifications and adjustments to the game rules. We hope you enjoy it!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32623881/429ba396aeffecbdec76d72c75d2bc2df584b3d9.jpg[/img]

[h3]Cards:[/h3]

[list][*]«Curse of the Undead» card is now placed in a hand and cannot be discarded for the rest of the game.
[*]The action of the «Grave Robber» card has been rewritten to be more understandable for novice players.[/list]

[h3]Rulebook:[/h3]
[list][*]Added clarifications to the «Hand Zone» section on which cards can be kept in hand and how to use them.
[*]In the «Inventory» section, the wording has been changed regarding the conditions for moving cards from hand to inventory and vice versa.
[*]In the «Encounters» section, clarifications have been added on where towers are placed after purchase, how to show them and how often this can be done.
[*]The «Skills» section has been updated in accordance with the current rules for the use of hands and equipment.[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32623881/032ac27401241c4595b7e26f233201d8cf9f686d.jpg[/img]

[h3]Other Changes:[/h3]
[list][*]Reworked game board rendering system.
[*]Fixed an issue that caused wound tokens to disappear after loading a saved game.
[*]Fixed errors and typos in descriptions of more than 10 cards.
[*]Minor text and localization fixes.[/list]

Thank you for playing [b]Fated Kingdom[/b]!

Happy New Year! More than a month has passed since the last update, so it's time to tell you what we worked on in December and in the last few days. The main component of this update is the ability to return the classic version of taking a card from the deck, in which the card does not automatically turn over.

Hardcore players asked for this feature. However, if you do not want to flip the cards manually, then you can use the auto-flip option without any problems. We also paid attention to the game balance, which is still not perfect. However, now we are talking only about minor changes.

The game has almost taken its final form, and in the coming weeks we plan to release a content editor. Work on it has been going on for more than a month, but there are still a lot of tests ahead. We also want to add some short explanatory videos to the rulebook so that it’s easier for beginners to understand some aspects of the game.

notes.title: Fated Kingdom is out now!
notes.content:
Early Access is finally over, and now you may try out the full version of the [b]Fated Kingdom[/b] digital board game. Over the past 17 months, we have released 35 updates, among which were both small and large. And now we suggest you take a look at the release trailer, which demonstrates all the key features of the project:

[previewyoutube=cYN8ADctwuQ;full][/previewyoutube]

If you looked closely at the game, but have not bought it yet, now is the perfect time to do it. And be sure to call friends, it is much more fun to play with them than with strangers from the net. However, you can always gather a group on our official [url=https://discord.gg/6YrV7n7]Discord channel[/url]. During the Early Access, a small but friendly community of board games lovers formed on it.

[h1]KEY FEATURES:[/h1]
[list][*] Old School Digital Boardgame Sandbox
[*] CO-OP and Multiplayer for 2-4 People
[*] 5 Characters with Unique Abilities
[*] 200 Well Designed Cards
[*] Roguelike Game Board Generation
[*] Realistic Physics and Great Visuals
[*] Easy to Learn but Deep Combat System
[*] Shared Physical Space and No Forced Rules[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32623881/27f7fb97ebdedc7995f061d87025cc7e9cdf3d83.jpg[/img]

[h1]POST RELEASE SUPPORT[/h1]
If you followed the development of [b]Fated Kingdom[/b], then you probably know that we had a detailed roadmap, in accordance with which we added new features and content. Sometimes we made adjustments to it when we realized that we were not in time or were ahead of the announced dates. Here is the final version of roadmap:

[url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32623881/141074191051febc742ce5f8245b46ccdca3c973.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32623881/141074191051febc742ce5f8245b46ccdca3c973.jpg[/img][/url]
[i](Click to view in full size)[/i]

Of course, our work on the game is not yet complete. We plan to release at least two more updates or more, if necessary. We also do not abandon the idea of ​​releasing a convenient content editor so that you can continue to play Fated Kingdom, adding your own cards, board squares and home rules. We are also going to add Steam Achievements to the game.

Updates will be less frequent than in Early Access. We plan to do this about once a month. Of course, it is very important for us to hear your opinion, as well as read detailed reviews with impressions, wishes and criticism. Our goal is to make the game as good as possible.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32623881/ab40d38c9497f324902d2000193ac012b159eb57.jpg[/img]

[i]Version: 1.6.38.200.
Download Size: 54 MB[/i]

[*] «Full Moon» card now does not trigger twice if the creature has two types indicated in the description at once.
[*] Inventory rules have been completely redesigned, now it act as quick access slots, where you can place items and skills, so that you can then use them during another player's turn.
[*] Several Rulebbok sections are updated to match new inventory system.
[*] All lists in the Rulebook are now presented in the same style.[/list]

[*] Added the ability to switch guild abilities on the Help screen.

[*] Fixed a bug due to which pressing the ESC key on the Help screen brings up the main menu, but does not close the Help screen.
[*] Fixed errors and typos in descriptions of more than 10 cards.

Thank you for playing [b]Fated Kingdom[/b]! This project could not exist without your support. We hope you enjoy what we have been working on for 3 long years.

notes.content:

Last preparations for the release! In this small update to the [b]Fated Kingdom[/b] digital board game, we fixed the problems associated with voice chat, and also changed several cards and squares to make the game more balanced. We also changed the effect of the two combat dice values that raised questions from the players.

Like last time, we did not add new cards. There are 193 of them in the game at the moment, and the last 7 will be available at the exit from Early Access. But we changed several existing maps by adding artistic notes to them. As always, subtle errors in texts and localization have also been fixed.

As for the release, we still can’t give an exact date. At the moment, we plan to conduct another sale, and release the full version immediately after it. Most likely this will happen in early November, after two to three weeks since now. We hope that you will be satisfied with the work that we have done in recent months!

[b]«Spark of Betrayal»[/b] - is the fifth major update of the digital board game [b]Fated Kingdom[/b]. And this is the biggest patch that we have ever released. The main theme of the update - battles between players. Most of the new cards and squares somehow hurt other characters. Can you eliminate all competitors and take the throne of Kinmarr?

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32623881/b484e5bcc74e4ec68c0a551b7c9338e1d1687a94.jpg[/img]


[h1][b]UPDATE FEATURES[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*]10 new cards
[*]Hotseat mode
[*]3 new board squares
[*]Refactoring and migration to new engine version
[*]Rulebook and balance improvements[/list]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32623881/fb35375f2f35e25b2503d16112d97357c08ce779.jpg[/img]


[h1][b]STORY[/b][/h1]

Undead, apocalyptic cults, ancient ruins captured by monsters - all these misfortunes put Kinmarr on the brink of existence. But what is their root cause? Some believe that this is the curse of the Old Kingdom. Others think that the profane research in the walls of the capital's castle is to blame. But others know that the reason is always the same - the human nature.

Even now, when there is no room for strife, people continue to be hostile. Animals do not rob merchants, and the undead do not care about other people's crops. On the roads of the kingdom dozens of thugs scurry about, and marauders gangs keep even big cities at bay.

Among the guilds, too, there are major disagreement, leading to bloody clashes during patrols. The guild Council is divided, even the Heirs doubt their king. It can not last long. One spark - and Kinmarr burned to the ground.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32623881/f3f66086dab848ee1fa3a88d53de96e99d9e56eb.jpg[/img]

[b]«Towers of Kinmarr»[/b] is the fourth major update for the digital board game [b]Fated Kingdom[/b]. It is time to tell about the consequences of numerous attacks on the kingdom and the emergence of hope for salvation in the form of Towers - ancient buildings that go deep underground. Citizens of Kinmarr believe they will be able to wait out the impending catastrophe. But it is not.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32623881/251c23b7d2dcc7e569df7656340de9c426c00a68.jpg[/img]

A full list of changes is available below, but first we want to continue the story of the game.

[h1][b]STORY[/b][/h1]

With the Dusktide cult in the kingdom of Kinmarr, truly troubled times began. Undead army advanced from the coast inland, destroying one settlement after another. A few garrison detachments died at the hands of the cultists or joined the Apostle of Dusk. The Watchers were the only glimmer of light in this kingdom of the night.

They fought valiantly with the dead, and then buried their shells in the ancient mounds in accordance with the traditions of the Old Kingdom. For a moment, it seemed that this was a turning point in the war against the undead, but when the army of Connetable Gothric approached the capital, the people of Kinmarr realized that it was time for them to seek shelter in the catacombs.

The reconstruction of ancient buildings, which once watched the rest of the inhabitants of the Old Kingdom, began. They were called Towers, stretched not only up but also deep into the earth. It is much easier to defend the Towers than the big city, and for the first time in a long time, the guild members have a new inspiring goal - rebuild all the Towers.

Perhaps they will save Kinmarr. Or become the last refuge of its inhabitants.

[b]«Dusktide»[/b] is the second major update for the digital board game [b]Fated Kingdom[/b]. It is dedicated to the struggle of the guilds of of Kinmarr against the mysterious apocalyptic cult. This religious community believes that the Ducktide is coming - the eternal night coming all over the kingdom. Cultists are extremely strong in their faith, and the one who guides them definitely knows more than anyone else.


[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32623881/520da6b3ed151c3b76b37c30098529aba45eded3.png[/img]

In addition to a large number of new content, we are very pleased to present you with an improved game board. Now it is fully three-dimensional and has side sections for storing cards, coins and cubes. We also made the 3D sphere of Fate and embedded it in the center of the board. But this is only the beginning, later we plan to decorate the board with a luxurious gold ornament and add other improvements.


[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32623881/34924280f9e4d3e52dfb7229c3fa3aaca9b71afd.png[/img]

The consequences of the undead invasion under the leadership of the rebellious Gothric the Connetable were terrible. The living dead slaughtered people in entire villages, and one of the cities off the coast turned into ruins. The mourning declared by the king did little to help the thousands of families who had suffered heavy losses. It seemed that endless sorrow soaked the air and even the very land of the kingdom of Kinmarr.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32623881/767509b24aa81e9fe4cbcb5d0f02a7bcf9b984e5.jpg[/img]

Caught in such a distressful situation, people often turn to higher entities for help. Thus, the Cult of Dusk was born - a religious group preaching the approach of the end times. The inhabitants of the kingdom saw with their own eyes the horrors of war, and therefore willingly joined the ministries in exchange for forgiveness.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32623881/cb56d87bf9cc40e1dfcfebb245cf613201a2151a.jpg[/img]

Perhaps this could have been avoided if the rulers of Kinmarr had immediately suppressed the sect, but it was lost among many other threats. Now cultists are everywhere: the streets are whispering about the doomsday, and dangerous religious artifacts have flooded the black market. Even among the guild members there are believers of this new religion.

Now there is only one way to stop the cult - to hit his very heart and kill the Apostle of Dusk!

During those 2 months that [b]Fated Kingdom[/b] was in Early Access, we fixed many bugs and added many useful features: public lobbies, Steam friends list integration, help screen, text chat and sound settings. We also improved the graphics by reworking the dices and coins, and adding new textures. Every 2 weeks we added new cards and squares for the game board.

In this major update we have prepared 10 new cards for you, each of which tells its little story of destruction of the Kingdom of Kinmarr. Play if you want to know it!


[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32623881/86a852c8993fcd901a3e735d1bfd20396d0e6ea5.png[/img]

With the first rays of the sun, a spear palisade appeared on the horizon. Crimson and golden banners fluttered in the wind. He blew from the sea and seemed to carry the hope that the Kingdom of Kinmarr will finally cope with all the misfortunes. Learning that the army successfully landed on the coast, the king immediately sent his fastest messengers.

None of them returned. Instead of hope, the wind brought a stench of death, mixed with the smell of rotten meat and salted fish. Many years ago, soldiers loaded it on ships to survive on enemy land. Now the army was slowly moving to the west, and the pungent smell of rot was spread all over the region. Places where people still lived, quickly emptied.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32623881/fe0b55fed4640ab6f9197a05f4986bb21cd3a472.jpg[/img]

It could not be a coincidence. The army, long ago sent over the sea, once again walked on its native land. Skeletons and zombies. Whole or in parts. On undead horses, on foot or even crawling. They all went to an endless horde directly to the border of the kingdom. Very soon they will overwhelm it with the ocean of blood and accomplish what Fate is predestined.

At sunset, the army of Connetable Gothric returned to Kinmarr.

Dev. Diary #3: Creating a Trailer
notes.content:
[i]Making a video of your game to show the general public is quite a non-trivial task for a small independent team. That's how we solved it..[/i]

The development of the indie project constantly forces us to yield and seek compromises. Much of what is available to major publishers and well-known studios is simply impossible to implement for several people. In the case of our digital board game called [b]Fated Kingdom[/b] and even less - only 2 developers. But this does not mean that you can make a mediocre product!

We are approaching the release. The project went through all the necessary procedures in order to be released on Steam, and the issue of presentation of the game arose sharply. Of course, we already have some promotional materials, but to create a page in the store you need a trailer. Many perceive it as if it's enough just to load the cutting of gameplay moments, but everything is a little more complicated.

[url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=qCAlmMqE1gw][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32623881/28d65c7039ce61e985801cbaef1dd0b1be48568f.jpg[/img][/url]

Trailer - this is a brief overview of the game, which has [b]2 goals[/b] at once. First, it must demonstrate the basic mechanics and features. This is necessary so that the viewer can understand what to expect from the game. Secondly, the trailer promotes the game, advertises it. Therefore, a good trailer always shows the game a little better than it is.

Indie development imposes a lot of restrictions, but both of these tasks are quite feasible if you approach the matter consistently and wisely. First of all, we sketched the general plan of the trailer: a short video synchronized to the beat of a stylistically suitable music, which shows the most important features of the game:

[list]
    [*]Classic tabletop experience in digital form;
    [*]4 player co-op;
    [*]Sandbox with no forced rules;
    [*]Realistic physics;
    [*]Dark and cruel fantasy world.
[/list]

In the team there is nobody to make cool cutscenes and write music, so we immediately refused the first one and began to search the network for the second. In the end, the choice fell on the composition [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=d2jQkO-dhiQ]"Division"[/url] for the authorship of the Kevin MacLeod, who provides his music under the license CC BY 3.0. Of course, we had to try hard to sort out the rubble of his music, but it was worth it.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32623881/80b8803e56ddf3f75c929df7bd950fee94a9f906.jpg[/img]

Next, we shot footage with GeForce Experience (supplied with the drivers of modern Nvidia graphics cards) and started editing in Sony Vegas. First two short animated splash screens with the logo of our studio and the Unity Engine that we use, then the gameplay, and in the end - an animated [b]Fated Kingdom[/b] key art with the mention that the game will soon appear on Steam.

The most difficult thing was to adjust the video with the music so that all transitions occur in the same rhythm. Also we needed a little understanding of the work with layers and effects to make a beautiful splash screens. Otherwise, the trailer is quite simple, but it does not look like the some average gameplay cut.
